description: OPEN INPUT at :120 reports FILE STATUS '35' - the dataset is not available - which takes the :123 arm, moves 12 into APPL-RESULT at :124, fails the 88 APPL-AOK test at :126 and runs :129-132: DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING XREFFILE', then 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM. Four lines and RETURN-CODE 12. The five seeded rows are deliberately present and deliberately unread: a failed open must short-circuit the entire PERFORM UNTIL at :74, so a translation that read even one row would emit two extra lines here. '35' is numeric with a first byte that is not '9', so 9910 takes its ELSE arm at :170-172 and the image is '0000' with the status overlaid at (3:2), giving 0035.
